verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state a capability to 'review diffs visually, run multiple sessions side by side' (claude-code-docs-13), matching the story almost verbatim, and IDE plugins offer inline diff viewing (claude-code-docs-19, claude-code-docs-25). However, it's unclear whether this refers to a true native desktop app versus browser/IDE-based interfaces, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of this specific UI experience. Missing for 10: confirmation of a standalone desktop application (not just IDE/browser), independent/hands-on verification of visual diff + parallel session UI.
